scope: Kaby i5-8250U Qwen3/Qwen2.5 Q8_0 strict CPU warm-session performance lane after SLM-CPU-184
claim_boundary: SLM-CPU-185 adds the missing model-init trace export surface needed to derive per-role/layer dense-linear bias role records.
This slice does not capture a fresh Qwen3 or Qwen2.5 hardware manifest artifact.
This slice does not implement, select, or enable a no-bias dense-linear fast path.
This slice does not change default runtime behavior or model output behavior.
This slice does not claim allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, Q4/Q5 runtime support, server, GPU/NPU/OpenVINO/UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 behavior.

fail_closed_conditions: Any required attention or feed_forward role is missing for any layer.
Any required role has present missing, null, or unknown.
Any selected role has present=true unless a later selector explicitly supports bias and proves behavior.
Output-head mode cannot be derived from lm_head_finish or recovery_path.
The exported manifest is not bound to model SHA, tokenizer source/strictness, selected backend, and fallback=false in a paired strict receipt.

required_before_any_future_selection: Fresh Qwen3 Q8_0 trace-derived role_records manifest.
Fresh Qwen2.5 Q8_0 trace-derived role_records manifest.
Strict before/after receipts preserving prompt IDs, generated IDs, decoded text, model SHA, tokenizer authority, selected backend/kernel, dense path identity, and fallback=false.
Receipt-visible no-bias selector identity and bias materialization counters.

validation.reason_hardware_manifest_not_captured: SLM-CPU-185 adds the trace export surface only; the next slice must run exact Qwen3/Qwen2.5 hardware traces and derive role_records artifacts.

recommended_next_item.recommended_action: Run Qwen3 and Qwen2.5 strict CPU model-init traces with BITNET_QWEN_TRACE_JSONL, derive role_records from model_init.linear_bias_finish events, bind them to strict receipts, and keep the no-bias selector disabled unless every selected role proves bias_present=false.

must_not_claim: SLM-CPU-185 captures complete Qwen3/Qwen2.5 role_records manifests.
SLM-CPU-185 proves all Qwen3/Qwen2.5 dense-linear roles are biasless.
SLM-CPU-185 implements or selects a no-bias dense-linear fast path.
Generated IDs, decoded text, prompt IDs, model SHA, tokenizer source, backend/kernel identity, or fallback status change.
Allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, broad decode latency, prefill latency, model-load latency, or warm-session end-to-end speedup is proven.
Q4_K_M or Q4_K_S runtime support exists.
Server, GPU, NPU, OpenVINO, or UHD 620 execution is involved.
Qwen3.5 or hybrid architecture support is in scope.
